title: Line heat source in an orthotropic solid: elliptic isotherms (analytic)
description:
Steady conduction from a line source (point_heat_source) in an orthotropic solid (k_xx = 4 k_yy, no cross term); everything outside an ellipse with semi-axes R sqrt(k_xx / k_bar) along x and R sqrt(k_yy / k_bar) along y (k_bar = sqrt(k_xx k_yy)) is held at T_wall (fixed_temperature_domain), so the wall is an isotherm.
Analytic (stretched coordinates x / sqrt(k_xx), y / sqrt(k_yy)): T - T_wall = P / (2 pi k_bar) ln(R / rho), rho = sqrt(k_bar ((x - xc)^2 / k_xx + (y - yc)^2 / k_yy)); isotherms are ellipses twice as long along x as along y.
Derived values tab: theta_x (probe 16 cells along x) and theta_y (probe 8 cells along y) lie on the same isotherm, so both have the same reference (~2.3 K); an isotropic k would put them 2x apart in rho. Expect ~1 % (staircase ellipse, lattice Green's function).
Line profile tab: T_rise_x and T_rise_y from 4 / 2 cells beside the source out to the domain edge (0 in the held region).

parameters.name: P_line
parameters.description: line source power in W per m of z

parameters.name: k_x_med
parameters.description: thermal conductivity along x in W/(m K)

parameters.name: k_y_med
parameters.description: thermal conductivity along y in W/(m K)

parameters.name: T_wall
parameters.description: temperature held outside the ellipse in K (also T0)

parameters.name: xc
parameters.description: source x: a cell centre near the domain centre

parameters.name: R_iso
parameters.description: isotherm radius R in the stretched metric (rho = R on the wall)

parameters.name: x_probe
parameters.description: x of the probe on the x axis (a cell centre)

parameters.name: y_probe
parameters.description: y of the probe on the y axis (a cell centre)

parameters.name: rho_probe
parameters.description: stretched radius of both probes (equal: 8 dx sqrt(k_bar / k_y) = 16 dx sqrt(k_bar / k_x))
